profiles.name: Tile signature
profiles.summary: A single Tile service identifier. A useful first radio check.

profiles.name: Samsung SmartTag signature
profiles.summary: Exercise the SmartTag service identifier rule.

profiles.name: Camera glasses signature
profiles.summary: Exercise the Ray-Ban Meta service identifier rule.
profiles.note: The on-screen label may be GLASS.

profiles.name: Raven signature
profiles.summary: Exercise one of the five discrete Raven service identifiers.

profiles.name: Google beacon signature
profiles.summary: Test the shared Eddystone / Google beacon identifier.
profiles.note: This UUID is shared with ordinary Eddystone beacons; a match does not prove a tracker.

profiles.name: Flipper signature
profiles.summary: Exercise the advertised Flipper service identifier rule.

profiles.name: Flock name signature
profiles.summary: Exercise the advertised device-name matcher.

profiles.name: Bluetooth module name
profiles.summary: Exercise the HC-05 advertised-name rule using BLE.
profiles.note: Tests the BLE name rule, not Bluetooth Classic inquiry or an actual skimmer.

profiles.name: iBeacon signature
profiles.summary: Test an Apple-format proximity beacon with a fixed lab UUID.
profiles.note: Enable IBEACON in SquachWatch TYPE FILTER first; it is off by default.

profiles.name: Meta manufacturer signature
profiles.summary: Exercise the broader Meta company identifier rule.
profiles.note: A company identifier is shared across products; the expected result is a signature match.

profiles.name: Ordinary BLE beacon
profiles.summary: A clean negative control with an unrelated service identifier.

profiles.name: Raven near-match control
profiles.summary: Check that 0x3101 is rejected by the current discrete UUID rule.
profiles.note: Older SquachWatch versions used a broad Raven range and may classify this as RAVEN. Record the detector version.

profiles.name: Flock Wi-Fi signature
profiles.summary: Advertise a lab network matching the Flock SSID prefix.

profiles.name: Axon Wi-Fi signature
profiles.summary: Advertise a lab network matching the Axon SSID prefix.

profiles.name: Pineapple Wi-Fi signature
profiles.summary: Exercise the Pineapple management-network name rule.

profiles.name: Deauther name signature
profiles.summary: Exercise only the deauther control-network name rule.
profiles.note: Ordinary Wi-Fi beacons only. This profile does not transmit deauthentication frames.
